reference: PLAN: 1. Find information about when "Peter and the Wolf" was released theatrically as a segment in "Make Mine Music". 2. Determine the release date of "Make Mine Music" to pinpoint the exact day "Peter and the Wolf" was released.

descendants_plus.hop_1: FINDING: "Peter and the Wolf" was originally released theatrically as a segment in "Make Mine Music" on April 20, 1946.
